observedFacts: GlimNavi Studio (/function-step3.html) structures webtoon production into 5 explicit workflow stages: 01 기획 및 각색, 02 콘티, 03 선화, 04 채색(채색/자동 채색), 05 효과(AI 그림자, 조명효과, 명암효과).

Line-art expression presets (#lineartPresetSelect) expose 6 controls: 얇은 선, 얼굴 보존, 명암 유지, 빠른 변환, 깨끗한 선, 디테일 보존, plus 컬러 레이어 분리.
Canvas presets support 800×600, 1024×768, 1280×720, 1920×1080, 2560×1440 via custom DOM event relight:setBaseSize and export options downloadCanvas, downloadAllLayers, and downloadPSD.
inferences: Each of the 5 lineart versions maps to distinct backend ComfyUI/diffusion controlnet workflows behind https://www.glimnavi.com/backend.
unknowns: Server-side ComfyUI node graph weights and authenticated credit deduction rate per v2.2/v2.3 pass require an authenticated backend session.
